info.title: LetterLens API
info.description: Explains German official letters in the reader's language. Facts are grounded in source lines; dates that cannot be grounded are marked 'please check'.

schema.title: Response List Languages V1 Languages Get

delete.description:
Delete the account and all letters. The data key is destroyed (crypto-shredding).

The sign-in account (email address, password hash) is deleted last. If that call fails, the
request fails and can be repeated: the next sign-in finds no data and deletion runs again.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: Normalized bounding box. The origin is the top-left corner of the page.

FactStatus.title: FactStatus
FactStatus.description:
Trust state of one extracted fact.

VERIFIED: the value occurs in the cited source line.
NEEDS_CHECK: the value is estimated, or the source line does not contain it.
The client shows NEEDS_CHECK facts as "please check", never as facts.

LetterDocument.description: The OCR result of one letter. Clients produce it on the device.
